observations: White industrial sewing machine with a large motor and a heavy base plate.
The brand 'Emel' is visible on the side of the machine in photos 0, 1, 2, and 3.
The machine is shown on a wooden table with a metal frame in photo 2.
The motor is mounted on the table and connected to the main body by a chain.
The machine appears to be in a workshop or storage environment.
The photos are watermarked 'POSTED ON JIJI I BUY I SELL'.

No photo shows this clearly enough to read.

claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The motor may be weak, noisy, or have a burnt-out bearing.

risks.proof: A photo of the presser foot assembly.
